title: Mom Abandons Her Two Toddlers At Home for a Night of Drinking
description:
On February 16th, 2024. Dad discovers that his 16-month-old and stepchild (7 years) were home alone after he got off work. After further investigation, turns out that the mom had left both of them without notice to go drinking with a guy friend of hers. She had also been previously arrested for child neglect in the past.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
